name: 13066 · Fayetteville, NY
findings: ZIP 13066 (Fayetteville) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13066 (Fayetteville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13066 (Fayetteville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
